description.value:
You designate a creature you can see within 90 feet as your quarry. Until the power ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, it gains no benefit from three-quarters, half, or one-quarter cover against you, and you can see it even if it is invisible. If the target drops to 0 hit points before the power ends, you may use a bonus action on a later turn to mark a new quarry.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd or 4th level, you can sustain concentration on this power for up to 8 hours; with a slot of 5th level or higher, for up to 24 hours.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
